name: Daoist Immortal Lü Dongbin
material: porcelain with famille verte overglaze enamel decoration
summary: This porcelain figure represents Zhongli Quan as a scholar. He is wearing a scholar’s hat and carries a scroll on his back. He holds a fan that, according to legend, could bring the dead to life. Thus, he also bears the auspicious meaning of longevity. On his bare belly, the potter painted a qilin,
